FINDING.summary: The #si-measured measured-read panel NEVER RENDERS at the pinned head: its inline script dies at parse time, so no state (ok/partial, full, stale, absent, outage, invalid, nodata, history loading/failed, generation mismatch, obs none/event/incompatible, unmeasured), no art-direction pair, no keyboard/deep-link behavior can exist on this page.
FINDING.root_cause: templates/sector_central.html.j2 opens <script> at line 3610 for the mr-panel block but never closes it: after '/* mr-panel:end */' (line 4118) the next markup is <script src="si_workspace.js"></script> (line 4124) with no </script> in between. The HTML parser therefore ends the mr-panel script at the </script> ON line 4124, swallowing '<script src="si_workspace.js">' as JavaScript text. The block's first tokens after the comment are '<script ...' -> SyntaxError: Unexpected token '<' -> the ENTIRE mr-panel script (render(), states, deep link, keyboard, history) never executes, and si_workspace.js is never even requested (it exists only as text inside the dead script). With no workspace router, .si-view[data-view=map] stays display:none, so #si-measured (inside it) is never visible.
